en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty-Section The Seventh Chapter
Discussion on Association:
Are there any states that are associated with any other states? Yes.

Is it not the case that there are certain phenomena which are accompanied by, co-nascent with, conjoined with, and which have the same arising, the same cessation, the same basis, and the same object as other phenomena?
Yes, they do exist.

If indeed there are certain phenomena which are accompanied by, co-nascent with, conjoined with, and which have the same arising, the same cessation, the same basis, and the same object as other phenomena, then certainly, you should not say [that all things are dissociated].
“There are no states that are associated with any states.
Is the aggregate of feeling co-nascent with the aggregate of perception? Yes.
If the aggregate of feeling is co-nascent with the aggregate of perception, then indeed, O sir, it must be said:
“The aggregate of feeling is associated with the aggregate of perception.
[And so on for] the aggregate of feeling with the aggregate of mental formations...
Is it co-arisen with the aggregate of consciousness? Yes.
If the aggregate of feeling is co-arisen with the aggregate of consciousness, then indeed, sir, you must say this:
“The aggregate of feeling is associated with the aggregate of consciousness. The aggregate of perception … the aggregate of mental formations … [is associated with the aggregate of consciousness.]
Is the aggregate of consciousness co-nascent with the aggregate of feeling … with the aggregate of perception … with the aggregate of mental formations?
“Yes.
“If consciousness is co-nascent with the aggregate of volitional formations, then indeed, sir, it must be said:
‘The aggregate of consciousness is associated with the aggregate of volitional formations.’”
Just as oil is inherent and permeated in a sesame seed, and juice is inherent and permeated in sugarcane;
even so, are those phenomena inherent and permeated by those [other] phenomena?
You should not say so… [and so forth].
The Discussion on Association is finished.
